__why: v1.7.0. The generic stub seeds every slider 0..1 linear unless told otherwise, and this plugin has no .planning/params.tsv to seed from. The target-preset buttons compute their write position from state.properties and light by getScaledValue(), so under a neutral range a click stored 0 (-36 dB on the readout) and nothing lit — the gate state 'target preset -23 LUFS lit' measured a page in which no preset CAN light. These three rows are the NormalisableRanges in PluginProcessor.cpp createParameterLayout(), typed from the source: gain_offset -40..40 def 0, trim -6..6 def 0, target_level -36..0 step 0.1 def -18.
